entities.summary: Chiara Caselli is an Italian actress. In 1994, Caselli won the Nastro d'Argento for Best Actress award for her role in Where are You? I'm Here as well as the David di Donatello for Best Actress award. Caselli has appeared in American films including My Own Private Idaho opposite River Phoenix and Keanu Reeves.
